text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki claimed a spectacular victory 
in the Satsuki Sho! The spectators lauded 
her running. Feeling embraced by the 
support of so many, she was immersed in 
joy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Feeling good about today's run, Yaeno 
Muteki felt a profound conviction that the 
path she had walked thus far was not 
mistaken.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown races are far 
from over. The next goal is the Japanese 
Derby!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer called Yaeno Muteki's family 
to report the victory. Her family seemed 
deeply touched, which appeared to serve as 
wonderful encouragement for Yaeno Muteki 
as well!
